kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From a variant of أَصْفَر (ʔaṣfar), the atypical /ع/ occurs occasionally in some Arabic dialects in replacement of /أ/ due to the pharyngeal-aspect of a nearby emphatic consonant, namely /ص/.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: عَصْفَرَ • (ʕaṣfara) Iq (non-past يُعَصْفِرُ (yuʕaṣfiru), verbal noun عَصْفَرَة (ʕaṣfara))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From a variant of أَصْفَر (ʔaṣfar), the atypical /ع/ occurs occasionally in some Arabic dialects in replacement of /أ/ due to the pharyngeal-aspect of a nearby emphatic consonant, namely /ص/.
